import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        String s = scanner.nextLine();
        boolean hasAt = false;
        for (char c : s.toCharArray()) {
            if (c == '@') {
                hasAt = true;
            }
        }
        System.out.print(s.charAt(0));
        int i = 1;
        int length = s.length();
        while (i < length - 3) {
            if (s.charAt(i) == 'd' && s.charAt(i + 1) == 'o' && s.charAt(i + 2) == 't') {
                System.out.print('.');
                i += 3;
            } else {
                if (!hasAt && s.charAt(i) == 'a' && s.charAt(i + 1) == 't') {
                    System.out.print('@');
                    hasAt = true;
                    i += 2;
                } else {
                    System.out.print(s.charAt(i));
                    i++;
                }
            }
        }
        if (!hasAt && i + 1 < length && s.charAt(i) == 'a' && s.charAt(i + 1) == 't') {
            System.out.print('@');
            i += 2;
            if (i < length) {
                System.out.print(s.charAt(i));
            }
        } else {
            System.out.print(s.charAt(i));
            if (i + 1 < length) {
                System.out.print(s.charAt(i + 1));
            }
            if (i + 2 < length) {
                System.out.print(s.charAt(i + 2));
            }
        }
        scanner.close();
    }
}
